Based on the image provided, here is the description of the screen:

**Screen Type:**
This is the **Main Menu** (Title Screen) of a Minecraft-style game called "VoxelCraft". It is not a world list or create-world form, but rather the initial entry point for the game.

**Visible Buttons and Interactive Elements:**
*   **Singleplayer Button:** Centered horizontally, located in the upper-middle area.
    *   Approximate Coordinates: **(510, 440)**
*   **Multiplayer Button:** Located directly below the Singleplayer button.
    *   Approximate Coordinates: **(510, 525)**
*   **Options... Button:** Located directly below the Multiplayer button.
    *   Approximate Coordinates: **(510, 610)**

**Text Inputs:**
*   There are **no text inputs** visible on this screen.

**Notes on Broken or Misaligned Elements:**
*   **Misaligned Text:** The yellow text "Also try going outside!" is rotated at an angle (roughly -20 degrees) and overlaps with the "F" and "T" in the main "VOXELCRAFT" logo. It appears to be placed haphazardly rather than aligned to a grid or UI container.
*   **Version Text:** In the bottom-left corner, the text "VoxelCraft 1.16.5" is partially cut off by the edge of the screen (the 'V' and left side of the 'o' are missing/obscured).
*   **Disclaimer:** The bottom-right text "100% CLEAN-ROOM – NOT AN OFFICIAL GAME" appears correctly aligned.
